snippet.title: Shard Squad - DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Assemble a squad of elemental creatures and face hordes of challenging enemies! Choose your Shards based on their synergies to unlock powerful abilities, and equip relics that will turn the tide of battle in your favor.

With the Wind Character Pack DLC, new possibilities arise! Harness the power of the wind with 4 new Wind Shards, each featuring unique abilities, agile playstyles, and new strategic synergies. Master speed, control the battlefield, and experiment with new builds to overcome the game’s toughest challenges.

Survive diverse scenarios, adapt your strategy, and fight to save your homeland!

Play Shard Squad now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363560/Shard_Squad/

Explore the Wind Character Pack DLC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4398470/Shard_Squad__Wind_Character_Pack/
